build_regnet_model: build a RegNet backbone model with custom width, depth, and group width parameters
build_any_net_model: build an AnyNet backbone model with configurable stem, blocks, stages, and normalization
create_res_basic_block: create a residual basic block with optional 1x1 projection for dimension mismatch
create_res_bottleneck_block: create a residual bottleneck block with 1x1-3x3-1x1 transformation and optional SE
generate_regnet_parameters: generate per-stage widths and depths from RegNet parameterization w_a, w_0, w_m, depth
